note: CP-2 Release B manual fishing. species: average weight of one fish (the hold stores kg; the number of fish shown is kg / avg_kg) and the icon asset id. profiles: how hard a ground is to haul (multipliers on the tension wobble, the surges and the fish slipping out). Provisional, owner E2.

spc_parrotfish.note: Reef fish, heavy for their size.

spc_yellowfin_tuna.note: A single tuna fills a quarter of the hold.

gnd_pilchard_shallows.label: Calm shoal: gentle pulls, the place to learn.

gnd_gannet_bank.label: Lively mackerel: steady pulls and a few runs.

gnd_kelp_reef.label: Kelp tangles: the rope snags, surges come often.

gnd_blue_drop.label: Deep water: heavy fish, strong runs, ease off in time.
